svg.title: Valpatel: engineering the systems behind intelligent machines. An operations overview links Gyropup, cad-agent, Graphlings, Club Fight, val-ark, Tritium, Sound Box and j501-agx-orin.
svg.desc: An operations overview in the style of valpatel.com: each product is a zone round a hub, packets run along the links, agents fly between zones, and the newest real events from Valpatel's public repositories tick in at the bottom (refreshed daily).
